name: Usui Jun
source:
1st year high school student. A member of the 'Kikujin' Shinigami company that is a rival to 'Yomi'.
Even though he's a shinigami he doesn't like killing things indiscriminately so he doesn't get along well with [url=/c44839]Homura.[/url]
Because he's an 'Amefurikouzou' youkai that's connected with rain he's always carrying around an umbrella even on sunny days.
He used to interfere with the protagonist's job often so now that the two shinigami companies are cooperating he feels a bit lost.
